findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-triggered-gate-mode-default-decision.md line 69 (Verification section) claims a regression test pins resolveDoneGateMode/config default to observe when unset, but no such function resolveDoneGateMode exists anywhere in the codebase (the real function is configuredProofStoryMode in packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:142-144), and no test in the diff or existing suite exercises the config-key-absent fallback path. All doneGateMode references added to packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs (lines 1650, 1815, 2274) explicitly set doneGateMode: observe in the fixture config rather than testing the unset/default-fallback behavior. The promised regression test for the default itself does not exist.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: the doc Verification section now names the real exported resolver configuredProofStoryMode (not the nonexistent resolveDoneGateMode), and block (c) of milestone-done-gate-reconciliation-smoke.ts drives that real resolver over a no-config temp root asserting the observe fallback (un-gameable: flipping ?? observe to enforce fails it). Confirmed by this round's docs + test-coverage lanes.

findings.desc: Dead code: packages/main/src/tasks/milestone-done-gate-reconciliation-smoke.ts lines 59-60 compute smokeName via resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), name) and immediately discard it with void smokeName on the next line. The variable is never referenced again anywhere else in the file (grep confirms only these two lines mention smokeName). This differs from the established convention in other tasks slash star-smoke.ts files, where the analogous packageRoot constant is actually used later (e.g. in execSync calls). Here it is pure dead code that should be deleted.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: the dead smokeName computation was removed from milestone-done-gate-reconciliation-smoke.ts. Confirmed by concept + quality lanes (no dead-code residue) this round.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: milestone-triggered-gate-mode-default-decision.md Verification section (line 69) claims A regression test pins `resolveDoneGateMode`/config default to `observe` when unset but no function, export, or symbol named resolveDoneGateMode exists anywhere in the codebase (grep across packages/ and docs/ returns zero hits besides this doc). The actual resolver is configuredProofStoryMode in packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts (loadConfig(ctx.root).proofStory?.[key] ?? observe). There is also no dedicated named regression test/smoke file for this default; CHK-009 verification used ad-hoc scratch node harnesses recorded as verificationEvidence, not a committed named test the doc could point a reader to. The doc should name the real resolver (configuredProofStoryMode) or drop the fabricated function name so a future reader can locate the cited guard.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: duplicate of F-001 (same resolveDoneGateMode doc-code-drift). Doc now references configuredProofStoryMode; block (c) regression test added and verified. Confirmed by docs lane this round.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts:189 milestone_ledger_add re-declares notApplicableDecision as an inline anonymous type literal instead of importing MilestoneNotApplicableDecision from core/types.js (already imported in this file); structurally compatible today but will silently drift undetected if the core type changes

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/tasks/milestone-done-gate-reconciliation-smoke.ts:434-521 new block (d) un-gameable regression only covers a fully-valid and a fully-bare notApplicableDecision; it does not add a whitespace-only reason/decidedBy/decidedAt case, so a future weakening of core/proofstory.ts requireNonEmptyString (line 221-226) to match the CLI schema non-trimming min(1) would not be caught by this smoke despite the stale-guard being the exact concern the fix commit raised
